$comment: Manual curation applied by scripts/curate-catalog.mjs after its mechanical rules. Keys are entry ids (stable: hash of repo-relative file + line + query). availableIn: corrects the version tag when the tested SDKs disagree with doc inference ([] = fails on every tested version). ignore: drops the entry with a reason. setup: extra preQueries/postQueries.

skipGoldens.sk_select_db70f2fe: firstRow on `cast` (array of MAPs) has non-deterministic inner ordering across runs even when row content is stable — keep rowCount only.
skipGoldens.sk_select_5055104f: LEFT JOIN + GROUP BY + ORDER BY review_count hits many ties at 0; firstRow depends on unspecified tie ordering — keep rowCount only.

unavailableReason.$comment: Justifies an entry whose availableIn is []. Without a reason here the runner reports BROKEN-EVERYWHERE and fails the run, so a documented example that works on no supported SDK cannot hide as PASS-AS-EXPECTED-FAIL.
unavailableReason.sk_types_mutators_14d30f05: Negative example: types-mutators.md §4 shows this INSERT precisely to document that a PN_COUNTER cannot be declared inline on any supported line.
unavailableReason.sk_operators_14c61b97: Negative example: operators.md §11 shows XOR to document that it is rejected on every supported line.
unavailableReason.sk_indexing_a5ca6e2a: Planner-directive illustration that pins two named indexes the pedagogical fixture does not create; the directive form, not the result, is what the doc teaches.
unavailableReason.sk_statements_a05a293a: TOMBSTONE is Big-Peer-only; the Small Peer rejects it with 'Tombstone is not supported' on every tested SDK version (4.14.4, 5.0.3, 5.1.0). Documented for completeness; not runnable from an Edge SDK.
unavailableReason.sk_statements_91f92844: SYNC CONTEXT is Big-Peer-only — the Small Peer parser rejects the SYNC keyword outright. Documented for completeness; not runnable from an Edge SDK.
unavailableReason.sk_movies_cookbook_0c22ec9d: TOMBSTONE is Big-Peer-only; the Small Peer rejects it with 'Tombstone is not supported' on every tested SDK (4.14.4, 5.0.3, 5.1.0). Documented for completeness; not runnable from an Edge SDK.
